title: KATHAAYA Story Package
description: One JSON object a Story Architect (ChatGPT/Claude) generates for Mythic Video Studio to import directly. See prompts/story-package.md. Mirrored exactly by src/studio/story-package.ts's StoryPackageSchema (zod) — that is the enforced runtime contract; this file is the published/external-facing copy of the same rules.

hook.description: The curiosity/tension opener — what makes someone stop scrolling.

emotional_core.description: The one feeling this story should leave the viewer with.

story_arc.description: A short description of the tension -> reveal -> payoff shape used.

facts.description: Claims directly supported by a listed source — see `sources`.

interpretations.description: Traditional or artistic interpretation, explicitly NOT presented as established fact.

target_wpm.description: Target words-per-minute for narration pacing (typically 140-170 for natural conversational Hindi).

id.description: Joins to the matching visual_manifest beat by id.

narration.description: The Hindi narration spoken during this beat.

characters.description: Only characters required by the story.

environments.description: Only environments required by the story.

visual_manifest.description: Describes visual EVENTS, not image counts. Does NOT require one AI image per beat — reuse master artwork through crops, details, layers, parallax, movement, draw-on/ink reveal and wash; generate a new master asset only when genuinely required.

sfx.description: Global/ambient SFX direction, distinct from a beat's own visual_manifest.sfx.

silence_guidance.description: How to handle pauses/dead air — e.g. 'no pause longer than 0.4s except before a reveal'.

sources.description: Reliable references. Every entry in story.facts should trace to at least one 'fact' source here.

role.description: e.g. protagonist, antagonist, mentor, deity, supporting.

required_views.description: e.g. face, three-quarter, full-body, hands, profile.

required_actions.description: e.g. raising a weapon, kneeling, reacting.

sacred_or_respected.description: Mythology rule: if true, this figure must be dignified and non-comedic — never a generic cartoon character.

important_layers.description: e.g. foreground crowd, sky/light, background architecture — what a compositor needs to isolate for parallax/crops.

required_actions.description: e.g. being raised, glowing, changing hands.

id.description: Joins to the matching script.beats entry by id.

narration.description: Denormalized copy of this beat's narration for self-contained context; script.beats[id].narration is authoritative.

scene_role.description: e.g. hook, stakes, threat, decision, sacrifice, reveal, payoff.

shot_type.description: e.g. wide, face, eyes/reaction, hand, weapon, detail, OTS, two-shot.

visual_action.description: What actually moves/happens — entrance, reaction, object/weapon movement, layered interaction. Avoid repetitive static full-body shots.

characters.description: character ids present in this beat.

props.description: prop ids present in this beat.

environments.description: environment ids providing this beat's backdrop, if any.

camera.description: e.g. push_in, pan, tilt_up, reveal_from_edge, reverse_push, shot_reverse, armor_crop, slow_push, pull_back.

reveal.description: Whether this beat uses the hand-drawn ink-reveal.

keyword_text.description: The on-screen kinetic keyword/emphasis text for this beat.
